title: orm-preflight configuration
description: Configuration for orm-preflight. JSON only, so a pull request cannot run code through the config.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor autocomplete.

orm.description: The ORM whose migrations are checked.

dialect.description: The database the migrations run on.

postgresVersion.description: The PostgreSQL major version the migrations run on. Some advice depends on it.

migrations.description: Globs of migration files, relative to the project root. Defaults to the ORM's usual location.

startAfter.description: A migration timestamp. Migrations at or before it are ignored, so existing projects can adopt orm-preflight without fixing their history.

defaultSchema.description: The schema of tables named without one. Defaults to public for PostgreSQL.

transactionMode.description: The transaction mode your migrations actually run with: the DataSource option migrationsTransactionMode, or the -t flag of "typeorm migration:run" when you pass one.

rules.description: Severity overrides, by rule ID: error, warn, or off.
